bigTiff: BigTIFF (TIFF over 4 GB) is not supported: save the image as a regular TIFF or as FITS.
notValid: The file is not a valid TIFF.
mixedDepths: TIFF with channels of different bit depths: not supported.
unsupportedDepth: {bit}-bit TIFF: 8, 16 and 32-bit integer and 32 and 64-bit floating-point files are supported.
unsupportedFloatDepth: {bit}-bit floating-point TIFF: 8, 16 and 32-bit integer and 32 and 64-bit floating-point files are supported.
paletteDepth: Palette-based TIFF with an unsupported bit depth.
colorSpace: TIFF with an unsupported color space (photometric interpretation {photometry}, for example CMYK or YCbCr).
compressionNamed: TIFF compressed with {method}: uncompressed TIFF files and files compressed with LZW, Deflate (ZIP) and PackBits are supported.
compressionUnknown: TIFF compressed with an unknown method ({code}): uncompressed TIFF files and files compressed with LZW, Deflate (ZIP) and PackBits are supported.
noPixelLocation: The TIFF does not say where the pixels are.
rgbFewChannels: RGB TIFF with fewer than three channels.
incomplete: The TIFF is incomplete: some pixel blocks are missing.
truncated: The TIFF is truncated: some data is missing.
missingColorMap: Palette-based TIFF without a color map.
